name: PDS Ltd
title: PDS Ltd - 538730 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: PDS Q4 FY26 is a cautious sourcing-services read: FY26 GMV up 5% to ₹19,666 crores, net debt cut to ~₹105 crores, guidance only mid-single-digit revenue and ~10% profit growth, with no volume-capacity or utilisation disclosure.

capex.quote: Capex during the year was almost reduced by more than half compared to FY 2025, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

triggers.label: Capex more than halved vs FY25
triggers.quote: Capex during the year was almost reduced by more than half compared to FY 2025

triggers.label: Net working capital ~4 days
triggers.quote: the net working capital days reduced from about 17 days, 1 year back to about 4 days at the end of FY 2026

triggers.label: Order book up ~11%, Americas ~30%
triggers.quote: our order book as of early April stood at about ₹5,074 crores, reflecting a growth of approximately 11%

triggers.label: Revenue mid-single-digit, profit ~10%
triggers.quote: we're maintaining mid -single- digit growth outlook for the current year and then close to about 10% or so plus broad growth in the profits

triggers.label: Customers pushing back on shipments
triggers.quote: last year also saw from time to time some pushback from the customers to hold the shipments

guidance.quote: we're maintaining mid -single- digit growth outlook for the current year
close to about 10% or so plus broad growth in the profits
we are anticipating an average 40 to 50 basis point improvement in the gross margin in the next 1 or 2 years, every year
we had said we will be able to bring it down to about ₹80 crores in FY 2027

prior_guidance_check.quote: gross margin for FY 2026 improved by 48 basis points to 20.6%

prior_guidance_check.metric: New vertical investment reduction to ~one-fourth by FY26
prior_guidance_check.quote: Our investment into new vertical reduced by approximately 27% during FY 2026

red_flags.label: Customer shipment pushback and cautious inventory
red_flags.quote: The customers have been cautious on inventory buildup as well is this caution that is kind of holding us back

red_flags.label: Brand/New Lobster losses; Ted Baker franchisee administration
red_flags.quote: It is when these retail franchisees went into administration that the agency sales of New Lobster to Ted Baker got impacted

red_flags.label: Management could not reconcile US Q4 figure
red_flags.quote: Our team is here, and we will surely look into it in terms of what is the plausible reason of that

evasions.topic: Five-year PAT target and FY28-29 numeric baseline
evasions.quote: I'll surely supplement that with the numbers as you asked.
Our team is here, and we will surely look into it
hopefully, we'll have some conclusion in the next four to six weeks
